text: We were visiting Tucson and after a long day we were looking for a  small family Italian restaurant. Nothing fancy, just good homemade food. We just happened to see Dolce Vita across from Walgreens and close to Sketchers on Campbell and Ft Lowell. What a gem!  The restaurant is small and has outdoor seating.  The menu covered all the bases. There were several items on there I would have liked to try but settle with linguine in white clam sauce.  It was a light olive oil sauce and pasta was perfectly done.  They served a complimentary farfalle salad to share. All entrees come with a soup or salad. Portions were large enough to enjoy for lunch today! Prices were very reasonable.  Will be back to try the Manicotti and we will save room for dessert.

I love this place. The food is absolutely delicious, I have never gone wrong with various salad, soup, and main choices. I am not vegan but try to eat clean as much as I can. This provides a perfect option for lunches during the week. And the staff is lovely and always hard at work preparing the super fresh food each day. This is the kind of place to support, because they are a small business but more so because it is amazing food!

Great atmosphere, very nice staff.  The soups are the best.  The cranberry salad could have more cranberries in it, and I was hoping it had a cranberry dressing, but it was more like a regular good salad with a few dried cranberries tossed in.  The sandwiches are a good price, but portions are not all too big.  Their soups are better than their sandwiches, though, didn't feel like the sandwiches were all too special.

Katherine the waitress was amazing! Awesome experience our first time here! Food was very fresh and the meat carriers were constantly stopping by! We even were able to request what meat we wanted to come by more often to the table!! We ordered the dry aged tomahawk steak aged for 42 days. It cut like butter and had amazing flavor!

Last night would be my third (and Last) visit to Asian Pearl.  Unbeknownst to us , we decided to eat at the Asian Pearl on the Chinese New Year..First Mistake.  Although it was crowded, we only had to wait about 10 minutes to be seated.  What I wasn't prepared for was the fact that there is NO Social Distancing practiced in this establishment and there are people standing everywhere waiting for take-out and to be seated.  NO organization as far as how people waiting for a table are handled four of us were escorted to a very tight and uncomfortable booth.  The restaurant is mostly comprised of booths a couple or small tables and one very large table.
As was the case during my last visits, there is ONE person waiting on tables and one runner bringing the food out of the kitchen.  Our server, and lovely young lady was literally sprinting through the restaurant to accommodate the oversized crowd.  She was gracious and efficient.  I felt badly that she was forced to work like a slave.  What kind of management would allow this treatment of it's employees and short-change its patrons in such a way?!
We wanted tea which is customary in a Chinese restaurant but were advised the hot water machine just broke down.  I guess boiling water in a pot was not an option?  trying to get her attention for extra napkins or chopsticks was impossible so I got up myself to get these for our table.
We placed our order and appetizer selection together realizing it would be longer than expected.  the F

Pretty good coffee. But I have to keep my comment on the food a little bit. It is good food, but not as what I have expected. It is basically all kinds of toasts, but a little bit too thin. I will come back to this cafe because they have such a nice view outside. It is just at the corner of the courthouse.

This place has the TASTIEST char grilled oysters in NOLA. But beware, they are loaded with butter! Your arteries won't forgive you but you will leave this place extremely satisfied. Be sure to walk around bourbon street to burn those calories. I would recommend to try this place at least once!!

I from North Carolina and I've eaten bbq all my life. I'm here to tell  you this is by far the best bbq in St Pete and in my top ten of all the bbq places I've ever eaten at! The owner, Dan, knows what he's doing when it comes to smoking meat. The ribs and chicken are my favorites but the worst thing I've had here was great.
Don't be fooled when you first pull up to this joint, it's a dive but clean and purely counter  order and take out. No indoor or outdoor seating but absolutely great BBQ! Try it and you'll see why I'm so high on Casper's BBQ.

I ordered the Burrito Suave and yuca fries as well. The food despite not being authentic Cuban cuisine was delicious(I myself am Cuban), my wife ordered their take on the Cuban sandwich and it was tasty as well. The server was great and attentive. Unfortunately, the only downside was the bartender not knowing how to make a Hemingway Daiquiri(less sugar, more rum) and the mojitos I received were pretty subpar. But overall a great experience.
So good! The corned beef special was amazing! Get it toasted!!! The fries needed some salt but otherwise the whole order we got was very reasonably priced and super yummy!

Amazing steamed dumplings!
Yummy sushi and teriyaki salmon cooked perfectly.
New favorite for sure!!!!!

Great beer, awesome food, and great wait staff. This is one of my favorite places to eat in Tampa. The food is unique and fantastic, and their beer is constantly rotating and always interesting. Try the bomb!

I was in Tampa for a conference. This place was recommended. I had a Cuban sandwich to go. From the bread to the meat it was a delicious sandwich. The staff was friendly and helpful. I wish we'd had time to stay there to eat since the ambience looked very nice.

11/22/2019;
Don't know why, but the food doesn't taste as amazing as the first time I came here. (I got the exact same thing bowl) 
What's nice about the poke bowl here is that there's choice of Half rice and half green. It's kinda healthy! And the salmon and sauce are good as well.
But they forgot to 1. Make my bowl as half half at first (but they changed it for me later)  2. add the poached egg

My friends and I thought we were going to enjoy a nice lunch together. However that was not the case. My salmon dish came and my other friend shrimp dish also came out within reason. But the fish tacos my other friend order didn't come until we were finished eating. 1st manager came and lied saying they had burned the fish and didn't want to take it off the bill but instead offered to give her a slice of cheese cake. But she refused. We had to talk to the GM to get it removed from the bill. Not please with management!!

Finally went to Casa Toro (before indoor dining was closed) and I had the best experiences. There prices were higher compared to other Mexican restaurants but the quality was better for sure - really fresh tasting food you can tell is made fresh. I got a special seasonal sangria which was really good as well as a burrito bowl with shrimp. The portion size was just right for me. My friend ordered fajitas which looked really good- I'll definitely have to try them next. Your dine in experience also comes with chips and salsa which was so fresh and tasty. Our waitress was also super sweet! She was super helpful when helping my friend with dietary restrictions  and gave a lot of great recommendations. She made the experience all the better! Will definitely be getting take out or dining in (once open)

I love Murph's. It's a wonderful neighborhood bar with amazing Italian food. Yes, Italian food!  Don't let the name fool you. The desserts are also amazing. The only downside to Murph's is that the ventilation is very poor, so when you leave, Murph's leave with you. The smell of food sticks to your clothes. Hopefully they will install a bette ventilation system.  Other than that, it's a great neighborhood spot.

The place is fancy inside.  I really enjoy the sophistication of the place.  The menu is also pretty stacked with unique selections.  I enjoyed the bean burger and fries.  It is nice to be able to find a place that will accommodate my vegan requests.  They also have a nice selection of sweets that are not so vegan but looked pretty tasty.

Our second night out in New Orleans and one of my friends that have previously visited suggested that we stop by to try their wings. We waited at least twenty minutes in line for the server to take my party's order. I figured that if we waited this long to get our order taken that the food would be delicious and I was excited to find out. I waited order after order seeing individual's in my party get their order called then I noticed that they started calling orders that had been placed after I ordered. At this point I had been I had been patiently waiting for my order for over 45 minutes and when I asked about my order, one of the servers told me that he didn't when my order would be ready. Eventually another server took my receipt and got my order served to me. It took over an hour for my order to be served to me. My order of A 6pc Wings tossed in Wuzzam sauce wasn't worth the wait. Terrible customer service & lackluster fo

Great option to bring visitors and give them a taste of some of southeastern PA's regional specialities - breads, various pickled foods, bologna - all sorts of local ingredients and meats. The egg sandwich is a reliable option, they serve Rival Bros coffee, and prices are reasonable.
A great place to enjoy outstanding pastas!  My shrimp scampi was outstanding a my wife's Alfredo was as well!

We sat outside on the patio in the evening with the heaters on and the firepit. It is a very nice and relaxing atmosphere. I had a salad with the salmon added. The service was good and the staff were wearing masks. The food was reasonable but is pricey for Tucson. There is a large beer menu. I would say great place to come for a drink and to watch the game.

19 sep 19 ****

My wife had the ruben egg roll appetizer. They were dry and did not have much flavor. It also seamed to have a thick crust. They seamed to come from a bag. 

The beer was as expected, clean and malty.

I had a ruben sandwich. It was balanced and well proportioned. The sauerkraut was drained before placing on the toast so as not to soak it prior to delivery.  The house chips were tasty with a bit of salt. Portion was a bit oversized. The accompanying pickle was as expected.

Service
Genevieve the barmaid made for an excellent experience. It was slow in the tavern so she spoke with us for quite some time. She stopped to help other customers and came back. Genevieve made for an above average dining experience which was reflected in the gratuity we left. Genevieve was the reason McGuire's received a four star rating and not a three. 

Well done Genevieve!

Great cheap food. Wings were a bit salty but has a very nice crisp to it. The fries were seasoned very well. Also got the bbq pizza. I really enjoyed the crust. Also plenty of outdoor and indoor seating that is socializing distant. Staff is super friendly too!

The food was very good and the price to food ratio was perfect. 
We ordered coconut noodle soup which was very hot and delicious. The noodles itself was very tender and the coconut broth was perfect.
Cashew chicken was good and nothing much else.

Moussalli's is much better than the former Andria's Countryside at that same location. The updates to the property are great improvements to the dining experience. The appetizers were wonderful and the steaks were superb. We were also so glad to find that a baked Escargot appetizer was on the menu - it's harder and harder to find at any restaurant, and this one is really marvelous. It's so nice to have such a great restaurant here in Edwardsville.

This is a decent BJ's location. The decor is OK, a little dated at this point, but considering that BJ's is a relic of the late 90's/early 2000's, that is to be expected. The food seems a bit pricey at first, but you get what you paid for. 

The customer service here is OK. Our server during a recent visit had been at the restaurant for quite a while, so she knew the ins and outs on the menu well. She had a lot to say about alcohol pairings too. Other times, it is not so good. 

This place actually has decent pizza, unlike the location on Oracle, which for some reason, has a weird tasting crust, and takes a lot longer to serve food.

We are mildly obsessed with Thai food, and after moving to the West County area we were looking for a new go-to Thai restaurant. The curry here is SO good and the service is always quick. We've been getting take-out recently with COVID, and everything has been consistent and delicious. Their portions are generous and prices are spot on. We love this place!

What a disappointment. Great previous reviews brought me here. I ordered grilled Reds to go. When I got back to my hotel the shrimp I had were very average size regular shrimp. Definitely NOT Reds. The garlic butter that accompanied them was not real butter, the bread was hard and the corn only had seasoning in one spot.  I don't know if I had eaten there it would have been better but the take out was not what I expected at all.

Ordered delivery for the first time here and wow my bbq bowl made my whole office wondering where I ordered from. The meat was so well seasoned and had a good fat ratio and had a ton of kimchi. I just wished they gave a bit more meat because of how big the bowl actually is
I used to always go here when I was little and it made a lot of great memories. The food is amazing. The vibe is great.

We were in town for the Berkshire Hathaway convention and found this hotel at a great price. It was in a great location (the "Gulch" with 2 yummy breakfast places, Milk and Honey and Biscuit Love within a couple blocks, but then we tried breakfast at the Killebrew Coffee in the lobby, and the breakfast sandwiches were amazing! The staff were always smiling and helpful. The room was quiet and overlooked the street where we could see groups partying in open-air buses. (I must say we were shocked at the number of bachelorette parties!) All in all, a perfect stay! We will definitely be back!

Love love that they do all you can eat crab legs on Saturdays. They keep them coming.  The price is 39.00 with two unlimited sides.  We have brought many guests here from out of State for this and bring local friends as well.  
The Taco special on Thursday is a great deal as well.  The tacos are good. Next I want to try the buy one get one fajitas on Wednesday nights.  
They have live music on Saturday nights which is enjoyable why eating the crab.  Great service.

Loved it here will come back.

Had a great time with my husband here. Loved the private booth where we could cuddle and chat. Drinks were great and although the menu is small everything we had was delicious. 

Great choice for either drinks before dinner or drinks and a light meal.

I've recently been ordering gluten free pizza from this restaurant. I really love the crust/pizza. That said, I generally call on Sundays and their delivery times are ridiculous. I'm always told it will be at least an hour and a half. My pizza came within 45 mins this last time. Today I was told the delivery time will be 1 hour and 45 mins to 2 hours. I'm sorry but come on! I could tell the employee was trying to persuade me not to order by telling me first that the wait time was 2 hours and then secondly by telling me, "you know this is a personal size pizza." Yeah, because that's the size you have for gluten free. I've even been encouraged to drive down and pick up the pizza myself. I know that I could do this, but I want it delivered. If you can't figure out how to offer efficient delivery service then don't offer it and let people go somewhere else.

Ohana is definitely one of my top favorites in Reno! They serve fresh and delicious rolls and nigiri. Their customer service from chefs to servers are consistently awesome. They have a great variety of rolls to choose from. Only rolls I'm not a big fan of are the deep fried rolls. Also love their hand rolls! For dessert, I always get the coconut lychee ice cream. Such a great end to a perfect meal!

This was our first visit after the tragic mudslides.  The ranch is looking great! We had an outstanding evening from champagne in the parlor to scallops and steak diane on the patio!  Food and ambience were as usual excellent.  We were out for our 11th wedding anniversary and our server Eric S. made the evening absolutely magical. Thank you Eric and all the stonehouse staff!  We will most definitely be back.
so tasty and good and yummy and delicious. everything i had was exquisite and the employees were beyond friendly. love wendy's

Heads up Kneaders Bakery! I have been here in Oro Valley three weeks and love your products. In fact, I have come at least 3 times a week for goodies and gifts. Each time I noticed your employee Nathaniel, who is exceptional even during the busiest of times. He greets everyone, listens, connects with customers and knows his product. 

Today was even more exceptional, when I mentioned the loaf of bread I bought yesterday was a little hard and I wanted to buy another softer loaf. He mentioned that his manager noticed the same and if a customer came in with a complaint they would replace the bread, which he did! He then smoothly uphold me on the number of amazing chocolate chip cookies! Now that is customer service and a great salesman. I was so impressed I asked if he owned the shop! 

So come in for great food, meet Nathaniel and enjoy! You want to be sure to greet him as with his intelligence, astute people sense, work ethic and really great attitude, he is going places! See you on the cover of Business Week and Forbes, Nathaniel!

At Mad Rex's Philly's apolalypse survival theme restaurant, and all the employees come up with the food from scratch by playing some kind of hunger games together. I asked my server if they had any toothpicks and they said, "We don't have any actual toothpicks... but something similar." So he went out into the arena and scored me these cuties.

I started my meal with some toasty pieces of garlic pita and a sort of carrot purée. Then Alex brought out my steak and taught me how to cook it myself. You have to be creative though because he didn't have any spoons and you've got to find another way to get your sauces to the right places. In the end it doesn't really matter because the steak is not only delicious (I don't often go for steak but this one was) but fun, too.

Beware of paying them with a credit card though, because there is hidden ink on the bill that's really an employee agreement so if you sign it you belong to them and they can contract you out to the Mummers Museum and a number of other Weird Philly establishments at their whim or they could make you play hunger games, too. But if you pay with cash you could go to Mexico and have everything you need to help someone start a killer food stand.

It's the end of the world as we know it (but everything I thought was just so important doesn't matter) and I feel fine.

Food is terrible it has little to no seasoning and a waste of meat to be honest, they have no French fries and the only thing I enjoyed was the bread and drink which honestly wasn't even good, interior design is nice though. If you're coming to Philly for a day, do not come here.

First with my friends was good but tonight I went again the fish they show on the menus was big long boil fish but they give me smoke fish small one and cold noodle just for those two dish I spent 39... dollars  too expensive and I was Disappointed on the spicy cold  noodle and got no Taste . The fish some parts are burn I have to look through and eat which is not bone on the picture it look like I finished it but there's a lot of things that I put it on the side.

Absolutely terrible, probably the worst location in Tampa

90% of the times they will mess up your order, today my burger was made completely wrong, they somehow forgot to put ice in my drink? And no sauce (which I asked for)
Chicken henry was awesome.  Service was great.  Loved the interior.  Awesome place.  Highly recommend

Wow I definitely understand why this place has such good ratings! 

We unfortunately couldn't add ourselves to the Yelp waitlist via mobile since our party of 5 was too big. We put our name down around 6pm on a Saturday and had to wait around 1.5 hours for a table. We went to the nearby Funk Zone to do some wine tasting while we waited.

We got a nice outdoor table that was far from other people. (Since we came during the COVID pandemic.)


DRINKS
====
STRAWBERRY FIELDS - YUM :) This drink was super sweet, delicious, and refreshing (just the way I like it).

WATERMELON SMASH - I didn't love the sugar rim. I didn't like this as much as my Strawberry Fields drink but it was still good.


FOOD 
====
FRIED CAULIFLOWER - I wasn't a big fan of this dish but it was unique to try. Not a lot of flavor.

BRUSSELL SPROUTS - Good! Took a while to come out but it was warm crispy and delicious!

MINI AHI POKE TACOS - I really liked this. No joke about the "mini" though. I split this with one friend and wish I had more but I wasn't trying to break the bank on this meal either.

TRUFFLE BURGER - I got a truffle burger and it was one of the best burgers I've had. Well I also really really love truffle so I was really happy to see it on their menu because I don't see it a lot. 

It came with TATER TOTS that were kind of boring. Probably the worst item I had in my whole meal, but I loved everything else so it's okay. 

The SIDE SALAD was refreshing, yummy, and a good sized portion.


SERVICE
==

The wait was kinda long but the owner treated us as if we were family I would absolutely recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting this part of the city.  The smothered pork chops were honestly some of the best I've had, the one thing I would recommend is checking them for fat before hand.  The pork chops however do pair really well with the mashed potatoes and gravy, which is something I would love to have again the gravy was extremely flavorful.
Solid Asian fare. Hardworking staff. Great for lunch specials which we usually takeout. Simple eat-in atmosphere. Fresh ingredients with nice size portions.

I wish they had better vegetarian options! There's just about nothing if you're not eating meat. I wish they'd at least offer their pastas or salads with a price minus the meat. My husband always likes their food, but it's too difficult for me to eat at to warrant a visit often.

That said, it is local and smells great when you walk in! The carrot cake is also pretty lit.

Defiantly my favorite place to eat in Reno! I love the highway to kale salad and vegan quesadillas. The staff is super awesome, we enjoy visiting with Tyler when we stop in. I appreciate their sanitation standards during this whole pandemic and will continue to support this business!

The customer service that we receive was perfect. I ordered fried chicken wings, candied yams, cabbage, and baked mac. I was offered desserts-- I chose to have the banana crumble (which tasted a little bland). The fried chicken was cooked a little too hard for my liking. Nevertheless, the food was still good.

We frequently eat at Taziki's and always have an enjoyable experience. However on this occasion the server Melanie was rude to the point of ridiculous. I waited as she took an order for two women ahead of me and heard them substitute the chips for roasted potatoes. When it came to my turn I asked to make the same substitution and was told that could not be done, when I mentioned she had done it for the other customers she said it would cost .75c more which she did not charge the other customers. This continued with each meal I ordered. But what really upset me and made me cancel the order and leave was her attitude and the way she spoke to me. I was respectful at all times yet she was openly hostile and as unaccommodating as humanly possible. Her retorts ranged from nasty "that meal comes with fruit or chips" to "that's just the way it is" when I started to ask with the kids meal "but can I" she cut me off and practically yelled "I said it comes with fruit or chips and those are your options". At that point I cancelled the order and left. Sad that Tazikis has allowed such a venomous and obnoxious person to damage their business. We regularly spend $40-$50 per meal there but will no longer be attending that location. 
Melanie does not at all personify the kind of staff we have become accustomed to at Tazikis. In addition to her deplorable customer service skills Melanie's appearance was unkept and dishevelled. Her uniform was dirty and she was brusque and rude as soon as we en

great restaurant on penns campus thats not super expensive. the food is delicious and there are many options for vegetarians and gluten free people. would def recommend for anyone who is craving thai food. their catering is also a+ and also very affordable.
Nice food.   awesom flavour....good portion ...afotable price....thank u so much for awonderful time

We had a wonderful experience, the food was amazing and the service was even better. Alex was our server, she was simply incredible, she definitely knew her wine and hooked us up with the best wine we've had in a long time. We ordered the steak and it was out of this world. I definitely recommend this restaurant, thank you Alex for making our dining experience so wonderful.

Un Caffé provides a delicious lunch in a relaxed atmosphere with delightful staff. The meatball sandwich was fantastic. It was served on bread that was fresh and crispy.  The sauce and meatballs were spiced just right.  The Italian cake was sweet, creamy and tasty.  This is the place for fresh.  I took the fruit pastries and scones to go.  They have dinner and movie nights once a month.  That would be a fun adventure.
Great food and great service! Highly recommend.. the margarita pizza was amazing:) definitely be back!
Love their food, order from here every time I travel to the area! Haven't been to the location but the delivery is always hot and fresh. Worth checking out if you appreciate classics

Was hoping to enjoy this place but the flavors just were not there. 

Service : mediocre at best . We had a big group and I did not understand why the waitress wanted to wait until every single guest arrived before putting in for apps , obviously the kitchen couldn't keep up with 30+ orders at once because some people who ordered entrees last got their food before those who ordered French Fries FIRST. Bad mistake on the servers part. Those fries were freshly frozen btw, not worth any sort of wait. 

Food : I did not enjoy anything tbh. The potato with mushroom and avocado was bland as can be. Did not know almost every dish would be served cold (this should be stated on the menu that they're cold). I had to ask for salt pepper n lime plus their hot sauces to make a sauce for my dishes. It's mushroom stuffing between two patties of potatoes and a whole avocado sliced on the side with an odd purple purée. Just in my opinion, it didn't look appetizing because green + purple ... and yellow really? Aside from the odd presentation, it was flavorless. I also had mussels, also cold, topped with tomato and onions tossed in lime juice. Again. No flavor. The mussels tasted frozen or out of a box which I buy often from the Asian market and it tasted just like that. I've tasted some people's ceviche, which is literally seafood tossed in lime juice, no flavoring or nothing, but for $30+ for that??? That's a bit ridiculous. I've tried the quinoa with mushrooms, also bland. Not an ounce of an

Seasons 52 is having a Roots & Vine event where they offer a 3 course meal for $29..95 (not bad at all) and a flight of a wine for $25.  We had reservations at the King of Prussia, PA location. Greg the waiter suggested the Cabernet and noted that the flight was a big money thing. It was better to get a glass if you didn't want all three of the wines offered so, I ask for a sample and liked it and went for a glass.  My friend tried the Pinot Noir and ask for a glass. Before she asked she asked how much the glass was and he advised probably $9-$11 which is what I figured and the reason I ordered a glass over a $25 flight of wine. After eating the manager came over and asked how everything was and we said Greg was great, not knowing that dear ol' Greg was going to then slip us a $146 bill for two people.  They had charged us $8.00 for a glass of wine, $14.50 for another glass of wine, and another $60 for two glasses of wine in addition to the $29.95 for each meal.  When we asked Greg why our bill was such much, he advised that they must have charged us to sample the wine and then advised that the glass of Cabernet was $30!!!!!! I would have never said everything was great had I reviewed the bill first!!!! They removed one $30 charge and an $8.00 charge and said the rest was due. Totally, ruin my evening! I will not ever go back there again! $30 for a glass of wine at Seasons 52! Not worth it!

Little day trip to Philly wouldn't be complete without a cheesesteak so Sonny's was the choice. 

Placed an order for pickup over the phone. Very simple and the lady who answered the phone was nice. 

I got the chicken cheesesteak hoagie with red hots and it was sooo good. I inhaled my sandwich lol. 

Would recommend and return next time I'm in Philly.

No doubt the Rusty Bucket has great food, but the service was not the best. I feel we were not given the same welcoming experience as everyone else in the restaurant. It seems like we were rushed out of the restaurant. It's sad your experience is not enjoyable when the restaurant  has great food. My husband has been to this restaurant multiple times and has never had the experience we did today....
I really enjoy Saturday nights here. The music and vibes are great. The tapas area really good and so are the drinks. They have great bartenders.

Crazy!  We waited over 60 minutes for our food!  The server never even bothered to let us know the food would be late.  I finally got a hold of her and she said they were backed up and walked away.  The food was just okay.  

The worst part is that our table was right next to another table, where they seated customers that were less than two feet away from us.  PACKED RESTAURANT AND NO SOCIAL DISTANCING whatsoever!  One of the servers had her mask just over he mouth, with her nose fully exposed.  We used to like this place but we will never go back.

I love World of Beer! The all outside atmosphere is so fun. The food is great and the beer selection is pretty good as well. I wish they had a few more local options but nonetheless they have many choices. Definitely recommend if you want to get away from the party crowd and want something a little more relaxing

When I used to live in Tucson I love taking friends to Zemam's Too and introduce them to Ethiopian food.  I had to take my boy friend when we went to Tucson last weekend and everything was as delicious as I remembered.  The spinach was the first dish I had when I visited the first time 5 years ago and it is my all time favorite.  The red lentils and green bears were delicious as well.  I always prefer the vegetable more than meat but the dora watt is delicious.  I'm already looking forward to my next visit!

I saw this place had good reviews and it was on our way out of the city  so we decided to give John's roast pork a try. It's small and located on the street corner. There isn't a parking lot so look for street parking or park in one of the big open lots across the street. When we approached the door, there was a sign that said, "call to place an order". I highly recommend calling ahead of time because I called at 2:00pm and was told it wouldn't  be ready at 2:45pm. I came back at 2:35 hoping that it would be ready sooner but I ended up getting my food right at 2:45 with "2:45pm" written on the bag my food was in. I ordered the mushroom cheesesteak and my mother got the bruschetta cheesesteak. They tasted fantastic! My only complaint was that it was a little too chewy! I was very satisfied with the ratio of bread to meat. You get a lot of meat and a little bit of bread which makes the price worth it. They have 4 benches for outdoor seating.

The OystERs are amazing.. I had the NOLA STYLE..AND THE RUM chaser drink. Shrimp Roni and Red Beans and Rice with CATFISH
.
We tried to order online the website wasn't working.   We called 4 times no one answered. It's forcing us to order somewhere else. Disappointed.

First I want to say that our waitress Gina  yesterday at 2:05 pm  (2/12/20) Gina was probably the best server I have ever had in the Tampa / Land O Lakes / Odessa area.
I had the lasagna.  It was extremely dry so I had Gina bring some more sauce.  The lasagna had a very weird after taste that I couldn't place at first so I only ate about 1/3 of it. .  I did  not (could not) eat the piece because of this after taste being so strong.  In the light of day today at home  I looked at the lasagna.  It was still super dry as if it were very old and had sat around for a while (days?).  I looked more closely and within some of the layers was green mold, which explains the aftertaste.  Of course I threw it away, but I wanted to report this problem.  My leftover piece was more than half of the original piece.   
 What a waste of money ! To all future customers , this is a warning-- be careful.

Now as a little bit of a backstory I used go to the highschool down the street from Tony's and Tony's was like a delicacy at my school, everyone knew if you had Tony's, the smell was undeniable and kinda strong but it was amazing. I swear to god in heaven when I tell you kids from 9-12th grade would walk over a half of a mile to eat those donuts. The best part about it was almost criminally cheap. A dollar a donut and that was plus tax, and if you really had money like that you would get a drink or something new like that. I have graduated from highschool,  me and my friends still, TO THIS DAY, go to Tony's for one of those fluffy, sweet donuts. The only reason I gave them 4 stars instead of 5 is because one time I went in and got some donuts and there was a hair on my donut that wasn't mine, I brought the the donut back to the guy at the register, he sincerely apologized( I think it was his hair) and gave me a new donut for free.

The server was nice, but when I walked in he was sitting on his phone and it wasn't until his friend told him that I was waiting that he decided to get up and help. Every food item that was displayed looked like it had been sitting out for a few hours and it did not look fresh. Out of everything I got, the seaweed salad tasted very old.

This is our go-to place for a bag of chips!! They are delicious and they put a seasoning mix on them that isn't just salt making them even more flavorful. The best part is this bag is only like $5 and lasts us a week or two. The staff is always super friendly and nice as well

Great coffee with lots of options and awesome supply of beer and wine at reasonable prices. I've never tried any of the food but they look pretty yummy. I would definitely recommend checking this place out!

We are SOOOOOO impressed with the food. We ordered delivery through door dash, and could not be more pleased. The salmon was cooked PERFECTLY- I'm so used to restaurant salmon being over cooked I couldn't believe how good it was. Not to mention the glaze they put on it is amazing! The green beans and roasted baby potatoes were perfectly cooked, full of flavor and well seasoned. We also tried the poke nachos- also really good! The chips keep a great crunch to them. 
We also tried the caramelized onion and bacon dip. A MUST TRY!!! It's incredible. 

Finally, we got a key lime pie for dessert. One of the best key lime pies I've had on the west coast! Perfectly tangy yet sweet. 

We will definitely be ordering again!

Slowest. Steak 'n Shake. Ever. 

Food is good. Shakes are great. But be prepared for at least an hour dinner - regardless of what you order or when you show up. I have contacted corporate and nada, not even a reply. They clearly don't care. Yet, here I sit.... we have been waiting 31 mins for milkshakes to appear. Why? Because my daughter asked for a shake from here :)
We had their takeout last night. Really great food. My husband loved the meatball sandwich and my kids and I really enjoyed the alfredo. Their bread is also so delicious! We will be back for sure

Stock & Barrel was a last minute decision and I am SO glad we did that! It was just before the rush on a Saturday night, there was no wait. We both just got a burger and fries thinking it would just be ok. The burgers were amazing and perfectly cooked. I never order burgers when I go out because they are either not cooked right or I just don't eat it all and it is wasted. I ate my whole burger here but didn't finish the MOUNTAIN of french fries they give you. We will be back for sure!
Unreal barbecue with unique styles. Great p great vibe and super friendly customer service! Highly recommended
Down home cooking at its best.  Nothing fancy, but just goo food and huge servings.  Lots of locals.  East bank, down river.  Check it out.

This place was  suggested to me thru yelp, and I must say, they hit the mark on this one!  It's a cute little deli that serves only gluten free food.  They have sandwiches,  salads,  hot entrees,  soups, and lots of bakery items.  I tried the ham and cheese with egg on the parmesan focaccia bread. It was AMAZING!! For that alone,  I can see myself becoming a regular real quick!! My mom had the Turkey and cheese on the rosemary bread, and we both tried a couple doughnuts, the red velvet and lemon.  Overall everything was great, from the service to the food! We went around 11am and got lucky enough to beat the rush, but shortly after it got pretty busy.  I watched them move through the customers pretty quickly,  so I wouldn't be to stressed about time if you're grabbing a quick lunch.  You can also grab something to take and bake, loaves of bread and other bakery items.  I definitely recommend checking this spot out, gluten intolerant or not!!
Stopped in after a ling time  for happy hour. Only good part about the visit was the beer. Wings and fries were super salty!

I am really bummed out to give a negative review to this place because I do like their food quite a bit but my visit on Friday night was abysmal.  Service was so non existent that we nearly wanted to leave. All 4 of our dinners came at least 10 minutes apart and made the dining experience uncomfortable at best. I will definitely give it another shot because it is normally very good but I hope the owners staff the place correctly or we will find another spot

Went here order the savory and sweet baby Dutch, and the taste is between ok and good. I like its vibe is pretty family friendly, warm type of diner. Good to have a quick bite, and waiting time is not too crazy.

I wanted to thank the staff for their kindness today-- I had some car troubles outside this restaurant and their manager(?) came out to see how he could help, asked his employees who drove to offer me a jump, and even offered me a hot beverage while I waited for assistance. There was hardly a beat missed, even though this is absolutely not in a busy restaurant worker's job description who probably has enough to deal with on top of COVID regulations. As a (now unemployed) restaurant worker myself, I wanted to thank you again for seeing someone in distress and offering up any hospitality you could!

This place is amazing! Exceptional staff, delicious food with a creative menu! My friend and I came out for dinner and drinks and wanted to try something new. The atmosphere and experience was perfection! Perfect for a girls night out! 
Highly recommend the Baja taco and the sunrise ! Sooo good
Worst Dunkin I have ever been to. Super slow service. Employees all seem like the don't care or don't want to be there.

I was at this restaurant with a friend tonight.  We split a Caesar salad and the Grilled Salmon Fresca.  Both dishes arrived as if they were individually made. 
 The salad and entree were excellent and well prepared.  I do not normally eat spinach, feta cheese or sweet potatoes.  However the presentation was immaculate and the food was incredible.  I cleared the plate.  The salmon was Atlantic wild caught and fresh, thus not having that heavy frozen taste. The patio warmers made for a comfortable environment and the servers were spot on time.  I cannot think of anything that would have made it more perfect.

Steamed dumplings, pan seared dumplings, rangoons, and the shrimp tempura roll were good. Fried dumplings were good but had to remove some of the wrapping, and the spicy tuna tempura roll seemed a little heavy on the batter. Will go again and try other things since the price is good! Also I'm sure things fresh in store would make it even better than the 20 min drive home.

This place is EXCELLENT. Seriously. Their chimichangas are superb. The crust is perfect, tons of flavor, tons of steak of the inside (most place skimp on how much they give you). The tacos are delicious, corn tortillas are nice and soft, not stale. The chips are nice and crunchy and a little thick, the salsa has lots of flavor. I wish I lived here so this could be our go-to Mexican restaurant. We tried to get tacos at two locations on Clearwater beach, and the service was so bad, no one came to see us at either location. We sat down here and a super nice guy came out immediately. Really really great experience. Just go here, totally worth it.

There isn't much to say in the market of a McDonald's review. It's not that it's known for anything too special - there are the standards: egg mcmuffin, fries, etc. etc. etc. 

I had a midnight craving the other day: you know the type. You drink copious amounts of coffee, chew some gum, and hope the craving will go away. Well here's the thing: it didn't. No matter how much gum I chewed, I needed a McFlurry.

So I ordered one: portion size? Great. Delivery time? Great. Taste? WAYYYYYY too sweet. In fact, I couldn't even taste the Oreo in my McFlurry- that's how saccharin this was. 

I won't be ordering again, for obvious reasons.

Omg! Let's just say I will be making trips to sparks now just to eat at this place. Not only do they have amazing food but their employees are so friendly. Marley was our waitress and she was fantastic! Honestly the best place I've ever dined in at. Highly highly recommend. And not badly priced either.

All of the staff wore mask and kept a safe distance. I was really excited for this place especially after reading the reviews. For an appetizer I ordered the clam chowder, it was way too salty for my taste. For entree I order the shrimp tri-color tortellini plate, was not a fan either. The tortellini barely had any cheese (not sure if they even make them there). I had high hopes for this plate but it was too bland, was also not a fan. Another person in the group had the catch of the day plate, I believe it was mahi-mahi, now that was delicious. But the rice it came with had no flavor. I would give it one more chance but I'd probably stick to the fish or shrimp. And not the soups or pastas.
They're always very nice here. They're fast and they get your order right. Food is priced reasonably and their drive thru is open extended hours. Highly recommend!

So so happy they opened this place in Conshy! I had tried their Ardmore location a few times but it was just too far for me to drive just to get a bite to eat. 

My lunch today was awesome, the food was fresh and delicious. I got a build your own bowl with shrimp and assorted toppings, and I mixed it all together and it tasted amazing. I will definitely be back!

I had an amazing experience getting takeout here a few weeks ago! We did the curbside pick up and they came to the car right after we called. They verified our order with us, included extra sauces and even gave us an extra cup of fries for the road. Not only that, but it was raining that day and the lady that brought us our food had an amazing attitude. The food was perfect!
Great pizza, garlic knots, cheese steaks, and pasta! Can't go wrong with anything on the menu!
Always ask a local. Up in Boise on vacation and asked a local for a cool local place with great food and ambiance. This place checks both boxes.

Came here when they first opened and remember the food being very reasonably priced and it was my first time trying Russian food so idk if it was legit, but it tasted good! Had solid flavor and keep meaning to come again. The service was kinda slow and they messed up my friend's order (corrected it) but I was rly happy with the food and price so I wasn't bothered.

We did a take out run to try some of the food, and we were glad we did. Even at 2:00 pm there was a short wait for service. We ordered devilled eggs, the fried bologna sandwich, and the smoked ham sandwich. I thought the devilled eggs were ok. Although the fried chicken skins added a good top note to the devilled eggs, all in all, they were only OK. Both the fried bologna and smoked ham sandwiches were truly awesome. I actually preferred the fried bologna, which surprised me! I found the smoked ham sandwich had a sweet taste that was just a little too intense for me. It would be my favorite if the sweetness was toned down just a bit. 
I thought this was a neat place with great food and a different vibe.

Wanted to love this place - prices were good, close to home and carry out during these weird times but...food was bland.   Both our noodle dishes were missing something - flavor although they smelled so good in the car coming home.  My medium spice was hot but not too hot but again, just lacked any real flavor.  The summer rolls, however, wer the best we have had.  peanut sauce was very good and the rolls large and full of veggies.  We will consider giving them a try again, hoping that the other reviews tell the real picture but this first time was a disappointment.

When I was in high school our math teacher always told us that the Smiling Elephant was the best place to take a girl on a date. Was he right? Was it strange advice to give to a bunch of 16 year olds? Maybe, I don't know. This is a food review app. Anyway if you're looking for something to change up your boring eating habits combined with a rollercoaster thrill ride on the parking lot hill, strap in and come on over to the smiling elephant. Bring a girl friend, bring a guy friend. Who cares, it's an old school Thai food place. Come enjoy one of Nashville's not so secret holes in the wall.
Not bad not good. It was fine. Nothing special. The staff was great and the place was clean and safe and warm. The food was mediocre. Way better options on every corner.

Top-notch! Unique food and cocktail menu that will blow you away!

We prefer to make it a date night but have taken the kids.

Definitely do the three-course meal so you don't miss anything.

Just ordered two tonight. They were fabulous. 1) Margherita and 2) Sausage. Loved thin pully yummy dough with blackened edges. Sauce was fresh bursting bright  tomato flavor exactly the sauce you crave. Blackened crust edges a delight.
Hikari's sushi is sooo good! They're doing a really nice job of outdoor seating and social distancing with a good vibe and good music. I highly highly recommend the Baltimore roll

I'll be honest: I didn't expect to like this as much as I did! Raw tomato and raw spinach aren't usually what I look for (or like) in my breakfast burrito, but they didn't distract from the meaty bacon or perfectly crisp hash brown. The only thing I'd change is that it needs more/better distributed egg (the ends were lacking).

Okay I have a number of complaints:
There's no ambiance. The wall decorations are sparse and uncoordinated. We were one of the only people in here eating. There was no music so it was really uncomfortable: we felt like we couldn't even talk without being listened to.
Also it was HOT. We were both sweating throughout dinner. 
The rice was undercooked and the naan was over cooked. 
The waiter never refilled our water. He also paid zero attention to us throughout the dinner. Despite being the only people in the restaurant it took 30 minutes to get our food. The Naan came out with out Main food which is fine but annoying considering we were hungry and specified that we wanted it as a starter. When we were done eating, our waiter took 20 minutes to bring us the check because he was on his phone.

We decided to try Rizzuto's after reading
G all of the great reviews and the reviews were correct, this is a great italian restaurant with some of the best Italian cuisine in NOLA. 

We ordered the eggplant appetizer and my wife said it was the best eggplant she has ever eaten. We also had the Crab Stuffed Mushrooms. OMG, drop dead delicious. So much crab. I ordered the Tomahawk Pork Chop. You can't go to Rizzuto's and not order this. Absolutely amazing. My wife said the Veal Parmesan was better than any Italian restaurant in New Orleans. We shared the beet salad that was just excellent and a Cannoli so authentic we thought we were back in Sicily. 

The owner checked our table twice, the waiter was really on top of his game and the busboy was very attentive. 

We are going back next month with my parents and cannot wait.
Good social distancing and employees wearing masks. Excellent food as always and at a great price

I've only been here for lunch and it's always good, although pricey. Parking can be a pain in the butt as well. Overall though it's a good spot for a quick lunch and they have a ton of options for everyone. 

They also have a small grocery section with a bit of everything and some local and healthy options.

We returned to Time Out despite our previous experience and had a much better visit. The hostess stand was staffed by two professional and friendly employees doing a great job on a busy weekend evening. Food continues to be mediocre at best but it was served in a reasonable amount of time. Our table was in a very loud area but we had not made a reservation and were happy to be seated at all. I so wish that they would shorten the menu, make a few tasty dishes with a focus on quality. It would be amazing to have someplace like The Butcher and the Barkeep in Skippack. This space is perfect for that!

My son was so used to pizza plus and I asked him to try pizza baron and we ordered today and MY TEEN IS SOLD. We got half nitro and half Asian flavors chicken wings . It was super delicious and the ranch he loves and the garlic bread is his favorite now . He loves the combo of it and will start ordering from pizza baron and bye pizza plus . 
I've gone to pizza baron back in 1990 odd keystone and none can compete with the taste and it proven today how my son is hooked . 
Thank you so much for great phone service to picking it up . We appreciate your hard work and never get comfortable keep rising for betterment .

The only reason for one star is due to the fact the manager comped our meal. Would be no stars otherwise. Restaurant was practically empty, sat at bar and could clearly see that no one started to work on our meal for 15 minutes.  They had to comp at least one other customer. Didn't appear to be much concern for customer satisfaction.

Wow!  This place was recommended by basically everyone and it was worth it.  Firstly it has an authentic feel.  There isn't any stereotypical Mexican restaurant decorations.  It feels like an actual family run restaurant.   Secondly the food was absolutely spectacular.   I had the carne seca tacos...one of the tastiest things I've ever eaten.  My wife had the steak fajitas and we were amazed at the amount of steak.  Normally restaurants are stingy with their meat but not this one.  The rice and beans were also above par.  We shared a queso fundito which was super rich and delicious.  Both of us had prickly pear margaritas that were also good.  Our server was super nice and professional.   Overall a fantastic experience and we will be back next time we're in town.
Best food we've had all week.  Grouper tacos are delicious and fries are fresh cut.  Great service and view of the water.

Beware of China House!!
I ordered China House through Door Dash and I usually have no problems. The door dasher delivers the food, she was polite and I had no problems with her. I looked into the bag and none of the food was what we had ordered. Upon calling the restaurant they were rude for no reason, said the Dasher had taken the wrong food and demanded that we bring it back in order to get out food. My mom went and finally found the restaurant and when she brought the food to the counter, the food was snatched from her. My mom tried to explain what had happened and what she had been told to do and instead of responding in any type of manner that would have been acceptable. My mom was yelled at, cursed at, and then threatened. My mom simply stood there while she was being yelled at and kept asking them calmly why they were yelling at her and how now all she wanted was her money back. Soon the owner called the cops on her for no other reason than that and the matter was "resolved". I contacted DoorDash about this whole situation, the company representative was very apologetic and was able to issue a refund to my mom's card without any fuss. Never again will I go to China House, if I could they would zero stars! iI can't say that I tried the food but if it is anything like their employees then I know it is disgusting.

Had the sausage and pepper skillet and it was not good at all. The gravy was gross. It was clear and watery looking to the point I didn't even realize that was gravy in the skillet at first. The peppers were raw and I didn't eat anymore of them after realizing that. I was thinking of sending it back, but I was with my parents and we waited forever for our food so I opted to at least eat the eggs, sausage, and potatoes and some of the dry biscuit that came with it. I'm honestly grossed out I ate the gravy though and regret it. It looked like some type of instant powder gravy or something because I could see tiny specs in it like it was some powder mixed in it which is kind of  concerning now that I think more about it. Hopefully I don't get sick. I give it a couple of days until I'm in the clear. I would recommend Cracker Barrel over their gross gravy. At least their country gravy is hearty and good. Guess that's what I get for trying a new mom and pop type of place. Definitely won't be coming back if that dish is any representation of the rest of their menu.

So glad we found this place. Great menu selection and I LOVE that they serve iced green tea (free refills!). A wonderful variety of sushi and Japanese food. We chose a crunch roll for my 4 year old, and they cut it smaller for her to eat, which was so nice. I chose the shrimp tempura, which comes with miso soup and a salad and a side of steamed rice. They don't substitute the rice for fried rice. The miso has great flavor! I didn't try the salad. The tempura was delightful, and the portion size for price was great - also not too much. We started with some edamame, which was cold, but it worked out for my daughter to eat it as she loves edamame. The staff was so efficient and friendly. We look forward to coming again.

So we actually had the food at a party that was catered . And actually had grits casserole for the first time and it was DELICIOUS, potato salad was out of this world, rice and banana pudding was on point. So we ended going to the restaurant to give another try of this yummy food. I orders their brisket platter with grits and potato salad , got to try their coleslaw ( it was vinegar base ) no mayo and i was all over that,  and bean salad was very refreshing, the brisket was so tender and juicy,  my husband had the pork platter with green beans and grits. It exceeded my expectations by far.
Great service, very fast. Cocktails and drinks amazing, food not so good. Got lamb shank and Fried Calamari. Bread tasteless.

Amazing 
Favorite place to eat in Madison
Amazing food. Love their sushi
Definitely a staple

The service and personal attention are remarkable. Comfortable setting with southern home style cooking. This is not a fancy restaurant but rather like someone invited you over to their house for a meal. The baked ham is tender and no knife needed. The bread pudding hits all the pleasure taste buds perfectly. Very reasonable prices.
Excellent restaurant with great food, service and view of the gulf. This was my number one favorite restaurant in this area. The hotel it is in is beautiful and you can watch the sun set.
We ate a delicious breakfast! Met other veterans in nearby tables! Serves, food, the Pond was Fabulous

Wow!!!    What a great experience. The food was amazing. Definitely get the croquets. Paella was awesome. Loved the atmosphere. That is just the beginning. The service was top notch.  Dan, the general manager, recommended a wine but gave us tastings of other wines for comparison and shared his extensive knowledge of wines. His selection was spot on. Later he helped us secure a reservation at a different restaurant that we couldn't get a table for. If I could give 6 stars I would. Check this place out. You won't regret it.

I LOVE Chili's. It's one of my absolute favorite restaurants, and I come here allllll the time. They have great food for a good price, what's not to love?? If you're a part of their membership/rewards program you get free chips and salsa as an appetizer so yummy, although it's VERY hot (spice wise) for me, so I just ask for a sugar packet and pour a little sugar in and it calms the spice right down without changing the flavor. My boyfriend and I both got the 3 for $10 in which you get a drink, appetizer, and a main dish all for $10. I got the chicken enchilada soup, which is a favorite of mine, it's sooooo good, best soup around. For my entrée I got the Cajun chicken pasta and omg it's so delicious. You literally can't go wrong with chicken enchilada soup and Cajun chicken pasta. And they have food for just about everyone there, whatever you're feeling like they got it. Definitely a place to come with the family and friends. I'll be back soon for sure!!

I couldn't go to this place in person unfortunately, due to covid-19. But I got their Vegetarian Jambalaya delivered and boy was it delicious. It's so hard for me to find cajun/creole food that I can eat because I don't eat meat, so I was very excited to see they served this. It was absolutely delicious and the portion size is so big, it lasted me for two meals. I can't wait to order from this place again!

The manager kindly refunded me for my purchase. 
That said, I will not dine at this location again.
Food was just ok. Service was a bit slow. Beautiful views , nice ambience. Calamari was really good!!
It was good, but nothing absolutely wowed me.  I think my expectations were too high. The cream of mushroom soup really turned me off as it was a blended versions and really didn't have much flavor

Went in tonight for the 100th time. Their guest/tap beers are great. My favorite pizzas are the cheese Louise and the slaughterhouse. Hummus is great. My least favorite thing is their breadsticks. They are very average.... service tonight was fabulous- we were a table of four and one person had to leave, but was coming back- the server put her salad in the fridge to keep it cold until she came back.  That was fabulous! Thanks, jackamo!

We made a reservation for a Saturday night at 8:30. We arrived 15 mins early and was told it would be just a few minutes. We had to wait until 9:00 PM to be seated. Our waiter was great and walked us through everything. We were low on time since we were seated so late.  The kids drinks came quickly. Our food came out pretty quickly as asked. The adult drinks arrived almost 30 mins after ordering and well after our food. My cocktail was meant to be a before dinner drink. Had I known the wait, I would have gotten wine. 

I am giving four stars to give them the benefit of the doubt. The food was good. Service can be improved overall. 

My trout was amazing. The pork chop and scallops were also very good. The cacio e Pepe butter spread was my favorite spread. The green garlic butter was only ok. We didn't get much bread for 2 spreads. The kids pasta was tiny for the price. 

We likely won't be coming frequently, but will keep it in mind. The choices missed the mark with one member of the family.

We came for 1/2 price shakes for a Valentines promo. 

We ordered on the Sonic app, which was easy to use. And once you arrive you let them know which stall you're in, and they bring out your food. 

The menu screen even gets loaded with a hello message with your name on it and lets you know your server's name and when the order is on the way. 

I got the Oreo Cheesecake shake and loved every bit of it. My husband got the salted caramel shake which was equally as tasty, but I always prefer cookie or a little crunch in the shake, rather than just smooth ice cream. 

It was a good experience. 

We have eaten here a few times for hot dogs and burgers, slushes, and shakes. 

Endless varieties of drinks. It's so hard to choose. 

I like the Chicago dogs. And the tots. We don't get over to Sonic as often anymore, living across town. But it's worth the drive every so often. 

You eat in your car and order at a menu in a stall. But as messy as the kids are...and prone to spills and drips myself, I usually prefer to eat at a table. Eating in the car doesn't usually happen in our vehicles if we can avoid it.

What a great local hangout. We went for lunch. Our server in the bar area was upbeat, pleasant and helpful and the beer selection is really good. Now for the pizza. I had the 10" Swine Apple and my wife had the 10" Great Hambino. I asked to modify ingredients and it was no problem for them at all. They really work hard to make you the perfect pie. They were both delicious, cooked perfectly and we had a few pieces left over so price wise, they are very reasonable. Between us we had 4 beers, lunch, left a good tip and had dinner later that night for $50. We will be back again and again.

Super delicious - came here while visiting Philadelphia for the first time and were not disappointed!

Har gow and turnip cakes are my favorite and were delicious. We will definitely return once we move here!

With the virus all around us, it's comforting to know Sun City Center, Hungry Howies is here to help us all get past this.  Again, my favorite pizza the veggie with pineapple, thin crust is just the best!  They could not do this any better, plus the delivery gal , is a sweet heart !  Keep up the great food.

I would classify Geraldine's as one of the "gems" of Indy dining and drinking scene. From the first step through the doors, feels as if going back in time to the front half of 20th century. Exposed brick with high ceilings, beautiful lighting with live music (pianist or 3-4 piece band thurs-sat) make the atmosphere hard to beat. The first floor if 21 and over bar and dining area while second floor is all ages white table cloth restaurant. The cuisine specializes in their red meat, specifically the aged steak is a must try. The blue crab cakes are my favorite item on the menu surprisingly. Pairs perfectly with a cocktail or two. Speaking of cocktails, they have fantastic drinks. Very knowledgeable bartenders who create some innovative drinks/martinis as well as the classics. Cannot go wrong with a boulevardier or old fashioned to match the prohibition style vibes. If beer drinker, this is one area of weakness I'd say, mostly domestic. Wine menu is fair and pairs well with red meat on the menu. The ultimate secret here though is their bread pudding. This dessert is a meal in itself, served warm with house made whipped cream and caramel sauce. Highly recommend!

I feel bad giving Bar Bombon 3-stars, because I love vegan food (I'm not even vegan), and their food is actually very delicious. But I have to because I think "will I go back?" and the answer is "maybe, but probably not anytime soon. So, that to me, is 3 stars. 
However, if you are Vegan, and OK with spending the loot, Bar Bombon could be 5-stars for you.

The place is always packed. That's good, because its popular, but bad because you'll be waiting. When you finally get a table, you'll be squished, or hearing your neighbors convo so close next to your table. But, I can deal with that if the food is worth it. My main issue with Bar Bombon is the high prices for such small portion sizes. We ordered 4 dishes, and 1 drink each, and our bill with tax was $70... and we left hungry! We just didn't want to order more because everything was expensive for the small sizes. The Buffalo Califlower tacos were amazing, I really loved them so much. But you get 2, and they are small, for $13. The peruvian Yucca fries were good, but not many for $8 or $9. The meatballs were $15, and not my style so I passed these to my dining partner and he enjoyed them more than me, but still not worth $15. The sliders were the best bang for your buck, and the most filling for the price. So, these were good. I would say the sliders and the tacos are the best, but the tacos win by a lot. 

I would come back during Happy Hour if a friend wanted to come, maybe they have better food specials. I love the concept
Good pub atmosphere, we have gone a few times and the food is hit or miss but the beer was always good
While renting a vehicle , I found this small cute restaurant. Great food. The place has a lot of character. Good music. Enough parking. Must try.

Ok / almost mediocre po boys. Went here as other good options were closed for thbe afternoon / evening. figured we would try them out. 

Shrimp po boy was lacking pickles, on really soft bread. Not the worst but def could use a little more effort. 
As could the potato salad. 
French fries were the frozen variety, again mediocre. Gumbo was OK, again nothing amazing but edible. 

Service very friendly. 

If its an only option open, it will fill you up but leave some flavor to be desired.

I've always wanted to try Nashville Hot Chicken. Since I'm probably not going to be in Nashville any time soon, I'm glad I found this place. Located in Armature Works, this places adds a nice southern flair to this increasingly multicultural food hall. This meal comes with a side of house made chips, pickles, and pickled red onions along with 2 pieces of white toast. The fried chicken is a chicken leg quarter that has a deliciously crispy exterior paired with a nice moist interior. The spice on this chicken is just right. Spicy but not mind blowing hot. Paired with the pickles and white bread, everything is in good harmony. Wash that down with a cup of sweet tea and there you have a very quintessential southern meal. I think my only qualms about this place is the price. I understand that it's in Armature Works but the price is rather high for not a lot of food. Additionally, no drink is included, meaning getting a drink is a further up charge. I think overall I enjoy the quality, but they can always play around with the pricing and quantity of food still.

Deep this place is REALLY GOOD!!! I got a margherita pizza with sesame seeds (a first for me), chicken fingers (perfectly fried wow), and their seasoned steak fries. I also grabbed an Italian tuna salad. Everything was sooo good, even cold, a few hours later when I went for a midnight snack. I'm going to be trying their sandwiches next!

It's everything you'd hope for from the local neighborhood bar. It's got good eats, a super solid beer list, and staff is quick.

Of the food options, I was a big fan of the wings.

I'd be more elaborate here, but I spent a lot of time here and got drunk really fast. I didn't drive home, didn't make any horrible mistakes, and I saw a bunch of friends...but my ability to really pontificate about the food options is limited. Usually I try to be more comprehensive of the food but I'm really dropping the ball here.

I guess what I'm saying is that I have bar ADD and I like to skip from spot to spot as quickly as possible. I didn't do that here. I love this place.

Went into Kiwi for some dessert. We ordered the strawberry lamington, mars bar, and caramel slice. All were amazing. We ordered milk, which they gave us a big cup of, and it went perfectly with the dessert!  Great find in a slightly off the beaten path location.  Lovely!

We discovered Pizza Luna on a whim. I am endlessly grateful we did, because Pizza Luna has hands down the BEST pizza. Their menu offers a variety of classic or bold options. Our children love it - we consider that a high honor, as one loathes pizza for the most part - and even our pickiest friend quite likes their food. Needless to say, Pizza Luna is one of our top places to eat in Tucson and the number one choice for pizza.
Food was amazing. The only thing that I wasn't happy about was that they ran out of rice paper
Was disappointed with the food here. Good atmosphere and drinks but the appetizers and entrees didn't cut it, especially for the price.

Loved the Philly Cheese steak!! It was piping hot and my friend and I still tried to eat it instead of waiting for it to cool. One is sharable but you will no regret getting one all to yourself. If you are in Philly please make this stop! You wont regret it!

Food was delivered two hours after placing order, and 30 minutes after the higher delivery time estimate. Food had to be heated up.

Felt sick within 30 minutes of eating the food.
Update: vomiting. DO NOT RECOMMEND.
